notes: *for joy* could be read as a supplied complement and marked `added` under rule 44, but `רוּעַ` is the jubilant shout itself, so the phrase writes the verb's own lexeme rather than adding a participant; the head stays on the lexical verb.
The supplied *the*s before *stars* and *sons* stand on construct nouns carrying no article morpheme (rule 29); `כֹּל` takes only its own *all* and the *of* goes to the rectum `אֱלֹהִים` (rule 19).
